description: This file defines a Python class SkipTagsAggregator that extends SimpleTextAggregator to prevent sentence boundary detection within specified start/end tag pairs, ensuring tagged content is processed as a unit.

classes.name: SkipTagsAggregator
classes.description: An aggregator that buffers text and prevents sentence boundary detection within specified start/end tags, useful for processing tagged content as a single unit.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the SkipTagsAggregator with a sequence of StartEndTags objects defining tag pairs to prevent sentence detection within.

methods.name: aggregate
methods.description: Asynchronously processes input text character-by-character, updating tag state and yielding Aggregation objects when sentence boundaries are detected outside tags.

methods.name: handle_interruption
methods.description: Handles processing interruptions by resetting internal tag state and clearing buffers.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the aggregator to its initial state, clearing all buffered text and tag state.
